products.title: Latitude 7450 Laptop
products.description: This Dell Latitude 7450 ultralight laptop, upgraded by IST Computers, is designed for professionals on the go. It features a durable magnesium chassis, MIL-STD 810H military standard compliance, and weighs just 2.33 lbs. Powered by an Intel 12-Core Ultra 7 165U Processor with Intel graphics, it boasts 16GB of 6400 MT/s RAM for seamless multitasking and a 1TB PCIe NVMe M.2 SSD for fast storage. The 14" QHD+ (2560 x 1600) Touchscreen IPS Anti-Glare display with ComfortView offers crisp visuals. Connectivity includes 2x Thunderbolt 4, 2x USB Type-A ports, HDMI 2.1, and an audio combo jack, plus Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 5.4. Security is enhanced with a Fingerprint Reader, and a backlit keyboard ensures comfortable use in any lighting. Running Windows 11 Professional 64-bit with AI-powered Copilot, it's ideal for a variety of professional and educational tasks.
